The pair began to provide structured cabling to northeastern Wisconsin businesses. Wire Technologies quickly became known for its quality work and reliable service. As networks became increasingly complex, Wire Technologies saw an opportunity to expand into information technology in 1998. The company remains family-owned and operated. Today Wire Technologies is owned by Tim and Steve Meredith, Rob Schuster and Opie Grishaber. By keeping the same values, quality work and reliable service, Wire Technologies has grown every year since its inception. As our company grows, the primary goal is to keep the responsiveness and flexibility of a small business and to uphold the customer service our clients have come to expect. Wire Technologies is one of the most capable communication cabling companies in the area. We are equipped to service enterprise levels organizations but will give the same quality service to the small office.
